capabilities: Chat with a local dsh agent in the sidebar
Stream replies with thinking steps and tool-call cards
Let the agent read and edit vault files
Reference vault files or folders via @ in the input
Sync conversations, archive, and deletion with dsh web
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian >= 1.5.7); requires Node.js >= 18 and a globally installed dsh command; per-vault conversation resume; bilingual UI (Chinese/English); not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; can also be installed by copying release files into the plugin folder or built from source.
intentEvidence: DeepShian brings DeepSeek Harness into Obsidian's right sidebar. There is no cloud API: it talks to the dsh already installed on your machine
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat, and most AI plugins rely on cloud APIs instead of a locally installed agent.

relations.evidence: DeepShian brings DeepSeek Harness into Obsidian's right sidebar
the DeepShian workspace syncs with dsh web, including conversation history, archive, and deletion

requires.name: DeepSeek Harness (dsh CLI, installed globally; Node.js >= 18)

summary: Sidebar AI chat that runs the locally installed DeepSeek Harness (dsh), with streaming replies, tool calls, and direct vault file edits.
